parsed.reason: Says what opens, when (Tuesday, September 15, 7:00 a.m., correct against Saturday the 12th) and for whom (Max and Mia). Names all four portal steps and keeps every handed detail right, in English. It asks the parent to report back rather than asking whether Hale should know, which is close enough. Two small drawbacks: 'I'll note that you're ready' edges toward a record the facts do not explicitly promise, and the tone is a little formal for a friend's text.
